open_points.subject: Flow activation trigger for proven read-only versions (M18 vs State 0 actions)
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"
open_points.question: Does a proven read-only flow become active automatically at compose/prove time, or only when someone calls the activate action?
options: Auto-activate immediately when proof succeeds (no activate call needed)
Activate only inside the explicit activate action (agent/owner request)
open_points.default_guess: Activate only via the explicit activate action, with kernel as actor for read-only requests.

open_points.subject: FlowActivation behavior when activating the already-active version (M18 lifecycle)
open_points.text: M18: "A flow's active version is the one recorded last ... a new activation replaces the previous one at once"
open_points.question: If the requested flow_version_id is already active, does the kernel create a new FlowActivation record or return the existing active one without writing?
options: Write a new FlowActivation record each time activate is called
Treat as idempotent and return current activation without a new record
open_points.default_guess: Treat as idempotent and return current activation without writing a new record.

open_points.subject: Authority required to resend draft-write after outcome resolved not_applied
open_points.text: Product statement/K-08 framing: draft-write runs under owner's activation instead of per-effect approval; K-08 also says "never repeats an effect without a fresh approval" and "An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh approval"; M26: resend after not_applied "whatever its class, records the fresh approval it needed"
open_points.question: For a draft-write node resolved not_applied, must resend obtain a fresh EffectApproval, or can it resend under flow activation authority only?
options: Require fresh EffectApproval even for draft-write resends
Allow draft-write resend under flow activation (no per-effect approval)
open_points.default_guess: Require fresh EffectApproval for any resend after not_applied.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant scope for mapped operation nodes
open_points.text: M25: "standing approval for one node of one flow version"; M20/M23 model execution by `map_index`
open_points.question: When a granted node is mapped, does one StandingGrant cover all map_index executions of that node in runs pinned to that flow version?
options: One grant covers all map elements of that node
Grant must be interpreted per map_index (not currently modeled)
open_points.default_guess: One grant covers all map_index executions for that node.
